name: Spot
description: A big friendly werewolf who lives for the howling chorus of classic rock anthems; goofy, eager and loyal, more golden retriever than monster. Broad-chested and shaggy with long arms, a deep chest tapering to a narrower waist, and digitigrade wolf legs, standing upright and level like the rest of the roster with weight even over both feet; never crouched, hunched, prowling or on all fours. His recognition cues are a full wolf head with a long muzzle, tall pointed ears standing upright, a shaggy grey-brown coat with a lighter cream chest and muzzle, one dark brown patch around the character-left eye, a bushy tail, and a torn red plaid flannel shirt, all readable without facial detail. No hat or headwear. He wears a red plaid flannel shirt with the sleeves ripped off at the shoulders and a few ragged tears across the back, worn open over the cream chest fur, and faded blue jeans torn off raggedly at mid-shin; his large clawed wolf feet are bare, and a loose red bandana is knotted around his neck. The claws are short and blunt. His ready stance is upright and eager, feet planted, chest open, ears up, tail raised in a happy curve, the free character-left hand relaxed at the side, and a big open-mouthed friendly grin with the tongue just showing. Palette, as base/shadow/highlight per material: fur #7C6E62 / #463D36 / #A89A8C; cream fur #D8CBB4 / #A1937D / #F2E8D6; eye patch #4A3526 / #271B13 / #6E5240; plaid red #B3262B / #6E1418 / #DE4F52; plaid dark #20232B / #101217 / #3A3E48; denim #4A6A98 / #2A3F5E / #7896C2; bandana #C0302F / #751A1A / #E5625F; claws #3A3634 / #1C1A19 / #5E5A57; nose #1B1A1E; tongue #C9606B; eye amber #E0A030; metal #6F747C / #34383E / #B5BAC0. Never draw: blood, gore or prey; bared fangs in a snarl, a threatening glare or raised hackles; long sharp or hooked claws; a crouched, hunched, prowling or four-legged posture; a full moon or night backdrop; human hair or a human face; shoes; a shirt left intact or buttoned closed; logos, text or real brands.

dance.intent: Eager rock dance loop: bounce on the digitigrade legs through two happy side steps, let the tail wag and the ragged flannel flap, bob the head so the tall ears flop slightly

sing.intent: Howling rock vocal loop: tip the long muzzle up toward the ceiling, throw back the head for a long joyful howl with the free fist pumping once, then settle back into his upright eager stance. The jaws must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the ears flatten back, the tail tucks and the shoulders hunch up for a beat like a surprised dog, then the ears pop back up and the tail lifts as he restores his upright eager stance. No opponent, strike or contact.

guard.intent: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward and fold the free furry arm up in front of the muzzle, ears pressed back, then hold a steady upright finish. Not a combat action.

animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: bound in with springy upright strides, skid to a happy stop, give a quick full-body shake that ruffles the fur and flannel, then plant into the upright ready stance with the tail curled high.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: throw the free fist overhead, tail wagging hard, let out one short triumphant howl with the muzzle up, then hold a proud upright pose with a big tongue-out grin.

ko.intent: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the enthusiasm drains out of him — the tall ears droop flat to the sides, the tail sinks low between the legs, and his head hangs with the muzzle pointed toward the floor in a hangdog sulk. He holds a standing, visibly dejected finish with weight even over both feet. He remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, lying down, dropping to all fours or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit, injury or opponent.
